port.description: TCP port mariadbd listens on. When exposed with network.ports[].expose: EXPOSE_VIP, keep it different from the exposed port (3306) and set it as target_port

rootPassword.description: Password for root@localhost and root@'%'; applied on every start

database.description: Database created on start if missing

user.description: Application account, granted all privileges on database; needs password and database

password.description: Password for user; applied on every start

bufferPool.description: innodb_buffer_pool_size, e.g. 512M; keep it inside the block's memory request
